headword: {割烹料理|かっぽうりょうり}
gloss: Japanese haute cuisine; traditional Japanese fine dining

definitions.gloss: Japanese haute cuisine; traditional Japanese fine dining
definitions.explanation: High-end traditional Japanese cooking prepared by skilled chefs, typically served at counter-style restaurants where diners can watch the chef work. Emphasizes seasonal ingredients, precise technique, and elegant presentation.

notes:
Combines ⟦{割烹|かっぽう}→割烹：11922_kappou⟧ (cooking, culinary arts — literally "cutting and boiling") with ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (cooking, cuisine). ⟦{割烹|かっぽう}→割烹：11922_kappou⟧ originally referred to the fundamental techniques of Japanese cooking: {割|かつ} (cutting) and {烹|ほう} (boiling/simmering).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {割烹料理|かっぽうりょうり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: Japanese fine dining restaurant
- {割烹料理|かっぽうりょうり}{店|てん}: kappo restaurant
- ⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧な{割烹料理|かっぽうりょうり}: authentic Japanese haute cuisine

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{割烹|かっぽう}→割烹：11922_kappou⟧ restaurants typically feature a counter where guests sit facing the chef, creating an intimate dining experience. This style predates the modern sushi counter. The atmosphere is more relaxed than ⟦{懐石|かいせき}→懐石：12635_kaiseki⟧ (kaiseki), though both are high-end Japanese dining.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {懐石料理|かいせきりょうり}: kaiseki cuisine — a more formalized, multi-course presentation rooted in tea ceremony traditions
- ⟦{会席料理|かいせきりょうり}→会席料理：26980_kaisekiryouri⟧: banquet cuisine — similar to kaiseki but designed for social gatherings, often with alcohol
- ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧: Japanese food — the general term for Japanese cuisine
